text.name: Rwandan Genocide
text.rules: Record "the world looks away". Until the end of this turn, points spent by either side count 1 less, never below 1.
text.history: Between April and July 1994 an estimated 500,000 to 800,000 people, mostly Tutsi, were killed in Rwanda; the radio station RTLM, broadcasting from July 1993, incited the killings.
